knowledge.purpose: Boolean checkbox input with label: consent or opt-in submitted as true/false, or one member of a multi-select group sharing a name
useCases: Multi-select group: several boxes with one name and their own values
Boolean filter written to page state with stateKey
antiPatterns: On/off setting that reads as a live switch — a checkbox reads as selection or consent, applied on submit
knowledge.implementation:
Further use cases:
- Persisted boolean preference

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text next to the box. Required in practice — the box has no name without it.

props.name: value
props.description: Omit for a boolean field: the form receives "true"/"false" under `name`, checked or not. Give a value only for a group of boxes sharing one `name`; then the value is submitted while checked.

props.name: stateKey
props.description: State key the checked state (a boolean) is written to on change; `{{state.<key>}}` then reads it (a consent lock, a summary step, a per-row filter).
